item.title: Tracy Melon remembers Mowzey Radio: “Music was more authentic back then”
item.description: Tracy Melon reflects on Mowzey Radio's lasting impact on Ugandan music, praising his timeless songs and expressing concern over the current trend of "bubble gum music". The post Tracy Melon remembers Mowzey Radio: “Music was more authentic back then” appeared first on MBU.

item.title: Beewol opens up about choosing radio over TV
item.description: Beewol, a digital influencer and media personality, has chosen to pursue radio presentation instead of television, revealing that he feels his profile is better suited for radio, and that he admires Ugandan singer Winnie Nwagi for her music, attitude, and work ethic. The post Beewol opens up about choosing radio over TV appeared first on MBU.

item.title: Ziza Bafana reveals why Mowzey Radio had plans of relocating to Rwanda
item.description: Mowzey Radio had plans to relocate to Rwanda before his death in 2018, feeling that he was underappreciated in Uganda and that moving to another country would help people realize his value. item.title: Bryan White’s wife, three others further remanded in human sacrifice case
